scenarios.name: Rush Hour — Hospital Road
scenarios.description: Peak morning rush. 6 cars, 1 bus, 1 truck queued at the Hospital Road x Gandhi Salai junction. Classic scenario demonstrating maximum time savings.

scenarios.name: Light Traffic — Night Shift
scenarios.description: Late night low-traffic scenario. 3 cars, clear roads, ambulance at high speed. Tests baseline performance under ideal conditions.

scenarios.name: Monsoon Evening
scenarios.description: Heavy rain degrades driver reaction times (1.25x factor). 9 vehicles in queue. Tests weather-aware prediction accuracy.

scenarios.name: Foggy Dawn — Highway Approach
scenarios.description: Dense fog with 1.35x reaction factor. 6 vehicles at a highway intersection. Demonstrates how our system outperforms even more in adverse visibility.

scenarios.name: Bus Depot Exit — Heavy Mix
scenarios.description: Junction near a bus depot. 3 buses + 1 truck in a 7-vehicle queue. Stress-tests the heavy-vehicle startup delay model.

scenarios.name: School Zone — Pedestrian Conflict
scenarios.description: School dismissal time. Pedestrian phase active with only 2.0s remaining. Triggers SAFETY HOLD — predictive system waits for ped clearance before issuing early GREEN.

scenarios.name: Market Area Gridlock
scenarios.description: Crowded market junction with 12 vehicles and high reaction delay (1.2s). Tests maximum queue capacity with slower drivers.

scenarios.name: Partial Flush — Ambulance Too Close
scenarios.description: Fast ambulance (150 km/h) at short distance (120m). ETA < T_clear → PARTIAL FLUSH mode. Demonstrates graceful degradation while still outperforming conventional.

scenarios.name: Telemetry Dropout — Fail-Safe Demo
scenarios.description: Live telemetry feed is interrupted at t=2.5s (simulated sensor failure). After 2s without heartbeat, system reverts to fixed-timer FAIL-SAFE mode automatically.

scenarios.name: Fire Engine Response
scenarios.description: Fire engine (longer vehicle, 1.0 m/s² acceleration). 6 vehicles queued. Tests heavy emergency vehicle physics.

scenarios.name: Elderly Driver Delays
scenarios.description: High per-driver reaction time (1.5s). Demonstrates how our system adapts prediction for elderly-majority traffic zones.

scenarios.name: Spoofed Signal Attack — Security Demo
scenarios.description: An unknown device (UNKNOWN-99) attempts to trigger emergency preemption with a forged HMAC token. System detects and rejects the spoofed signal. Legitimate AMB-01 request succeeds.
